result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but the bottom navigation area appears clipped/cropped, which is the most significant visual problem. A few carousel/card items are also cut off at the viewport edges, though some of that may be expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: Bottom navigation bar is partially cut off at the bottom edge; the search/cart/profile icons appear cropped and tab labels are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Adjust bottom safe-area padding and tab bar height so all navigation icons/labels are fully visible above the system gesture area.

issues.description: The right-most category chip and the right edge of the 'Fastest near you' carousel are visibly clipped, making content feel cropped.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer edge fade/scroll affordance or ensure partially visible items have enough margin to look intentionally scrollable rather than broken.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' card.
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line titles, reduce font size slightly, or widen cards so restaurant names remain readable.
